result.brief: 提出 Glance Forcing 轻量蒸馏框架，将双向扩散教师转为因果少步自回归视频生成器，按高/低噪声阶段解耦为慢快双专家并仅用单条 PF-ODE 轨迹监督，大幅降低轨迹采集成本并提升 VBench 与动态度。
result.reason: Distills bidirectional video diffusion into causal autoregressive few-step student for real-time video synthesis and world models; contributes training/distillation method for video generation.
